text: Done, v0.114.15: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v0.114.15 . Settings > Cloud scan now has 'Run now (even outside its hours)' and 'Stop now', with a line saying what state it's in. RUN lets the engine work outside 8am-1am ET (until the window opens by itself, 12 h at most) and asks GitHub to start it. STOP ends the engine, takes its bids down, and keeps it off only until the NEXT scheduled opening (8am ET), then it starts by itself. Neither touches the schedule, the 15-minute start check or the 6-hour hand-overs; both lapse on their own. Needs 'Cloud scan' switched on. The workflow change is already live on GitHub; the buttons need the app update.
